items.title: Herbarium Graduate Assistantship, University of Tennessee at Chattanooga
items.snippet: The Shaw Lab at the University of Tennessee at Chattanooga is seeking a Master's student interested in botanical research who is also looking gain experience running and growing a mid-sized herbarium from 50,000 to 65,000 specimens.

items.title: Plant Ecology Professorship, University of Tennessee at Chattanooga
items.snippet: The Department of Biology, Geology, and Environmental Science (BGE) at the University of Tennessee at Chattanooga (UTC) in the College of Arts and Sciences invites applications for a tenure-track Assistant Professor in Plant Ecology beginning August 1, 2027.
